text: We have interviewed 18 customers and three agreed to an unpaid pilot. We have not tested pricing yet.
Everyone will love this. We will take over the whole market immediately.
Our product makes everything better through innovation and synergy.
The customer uploads the same sales CSV they already export; we return a daily preparation checklist.
We will build every integration in a week even though we have no engineering team.
We charge 79 dollars per month. Three pilot users signed letters agreeing to this price, but no money has changed hands.
Actually I misspoke: we have three pilots, not thirty. None are paying yet.
Our distribution plan is to go viral. We have no specific channel or launch experiment planned.
I cannot answer whether people would switch yet. Next week we will observe five shop owners using their current workflow.
We plan to launch a CSV-only prototype before building integrations. The first test is whether managers use the checklist each morning.
Our revenue will reach a million next month because the market is huge.
You asked about price, but let me tell you how beautiful our branding is instead.
